modmenu.descriptionTranslation.imperium_: European empire simulation expansion for MineColonies.
imperium_realms.gui.title: IMPERIAL LEDGER
imperium_realms.gui.help: Tax and policy controls submit bills. The Emperor reviews them in Parliament; all actions are server-validated.
com.imperium_realms.building.imperial_ar: A five-tier administrative, scholarly and diplomatic hut for Philosophers, Tax Collectors and Diplomats. Original Structurize blueprints are included.
imperium_realms.message.player_required: This command must be used by a player in a MineColonies colony.
imperium_realms.message.enter_colony: Stand inside a MineColonies colony to access its imperial ledger.
imperium_realms.message.ledger_missing: The imperial ledger could not initialize for this colony.
imperium_realms.message.tax_unchanged: Tax rate unchanged. Choose a rate from 0 to 25 percent.
imperium_realms.message.tax_proposal_inv: Cannot propose %1$d%% tax: the rate is invalid, already active, or an identical open proposal exists. Current rate: %2$d%%.
imperium_realms.message.tax_proposed: Tax proposal #%1$d submitted: %2$d%%. Council votes: %3$d for, %4$d against. Expires after day %5$d. Use /imperium parliament status, then assent or veto #%1$d.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_empty: There are no saved parliamentary proposals.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_propo: Bill #%1$d (%2$s): %3$s by %4$s §7| Council: %5$d for / %6$d against §7| Status: %7$s §7| Expires day %8$d §7| Resolved by %9$s on day %10$s
imperium_realms.message.parliament_instr: Use /imperium parliament propose-policy <policy> to submit policy bills, /imperium parliament assent <id> to approve, or /imperium parliament veto <id> to reject a bill.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_propo: No parliamentary bill with ID #%1$d exists.
Parliamentary bill #%1$d is no longer open.
Bill #%1$d passed. The daily tax rate is now %2$d%%.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_no_ma: The council's votes blocked bill #%1$d; the parliamentary majority was not reached.
imperium_realms.message.policy_unknown: Unknown policy. Choose balanced, mercantile, welfare, or austerity.
imperium_realms.message.policy_proposal_: Cannot propose policy %1$s: it is already active or an identical open proposal exists. Current policy: %2$s.
imperium_realms.message.policy_proposed: Policy proposal #%1$d submitted: %2$s. Council votes: %3$d for, %4$d against. Expires after day %5$d.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_polic: Bill #%1$d passed. Economic policy is now %2$s.
imperium_realms.message.policy_changed: Economic policy changed to %1$s. Its tax and stability effects apply on the next daily turn.
imperium_realms.message.invest_multiple: Investments must be a multiple of 10 crowns.
imperium_realms.message.treasury_insuffi: The treasury does not contain enough crowns.
imperium_realms.message.invest_success: Invested %1$d crowns into %2$d knowledge point(s). Treasury balance: %3$d crowns.
imperium_realms.message.permission_denie: You need colony hut-management permission or operator permission to change the imperial economy.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_empty: No diplomatic relations have been recorded yet.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_instru: Use /imperium diplomacy improve <colonyId> to spend 10 influence and improve that relation by 5 points. A Diplomat at the Imperial Archive generates influence.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_target: No MineColonies colony with ID #%1$d was found in this dimension.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_self_t: A colony cannot improve diplomatic relations with itself.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_influe: You need at least 10 diplomatic influence to improve a relation.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_relati: Relations with %1$s are already at the maximum score.
imperium_realms.message.diplomacy_improv: The diplomatic relation could not be changed.
Relations with %1$s improved to %2$s (%3$d/100). Remaining influence: %4$d.
imperium_realms.message.politics_help: Use /imperium politics to review faction approval. Lower taxes, citizen happiness and Welfare policy can reduce unrest over time. Strikes halve tax income; revolts reduce it to 10%.
com.imperium_realms.building.imperial_gu: A five-tier specialist guard tower for Imperial Siege Engineers, Field Medics and Cavaliers. Original Structurize blueprints are included.
imperium_realms.message.army_help: Specialist guard level-ups train these disciplines. Use an Imperial Guard Tower to hire the native MineColonies roles; custom Structurize blueprints are still required for survival construction.
imperium_realms.message.province_help: Use /imperium province focus <agriculture|trade|scholarship|military|civic> to specialize. /imperium province develop spends 10 knowledge to advance the province.
imperium_realms.message.province_focus_u: Unknown province focus. Choose agriculture, trade, scholarship, military, or civic.
The province is already specialized in %1$s.
imperium_realms.message.province_focus_s: Province focus changed to %1$s. Its effects apply on the server's daily turn.
imperium_realms.message.province_fully_d: This province has reached the highest administrative tier.
imperium_realms.message.province_knowled: Developing a province costs 10 knowledge points.
imperium_realms.message.province_develop: The province could not be developed.
Province advanced toward %1$s. Development: %2$d/1000. Remaining knowledge: %3$d.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_header: Strategic operations for %1$s — Treasury: %2$d crowns | Influence: %3$d | Active: %4$d
imperium_realms.message.campaign_empty: No strategic operations have been recorded.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_entry: #%1$d — %2$s against %3$s | Result: %4$s | Started day %5$d | Due day %6$d | Resolved day %7$s
imperium_realms.message.campaign_help: Use /imperium campaign launch <border_patrol|relief_expedition|war_campaign> <colonyId>. Up to three operations may run concurrently against distinct targets. Use /imperium campaign posture <balanced|defensive|offensive> to set doctrine. Operations resolve on the daily server turn; territory is never automatically transferred.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_type_un: Unknown operation. Choose border_patrol, relief_expedition or war_campaign.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_target_: No MineColonies colony with ID %1$d exists in this dimension.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_self_ta: An operation must target another colony.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_already: An operation is already active against that target. Resolve it before launching another operation against the same colony.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_crowns_: This operation costs %1$d crowns; the treasury cannot cover it.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_trainin: This operation needs at least %1$d specialist military training points.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_target_: A strategic war cannot be launched against an allied colony. Review relations first.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_launch_: The operation could not be launched. Check the target, treasury, influence and active operations.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_launche: Operation #%1$d — %2$s against %3$s has begun. It resolves on in-game day %4$d.
imperium_realms.message.empire_none: This colony is not part of an imperial realm.
imperium_realms.message.empire_found_hel: Use /imperium empire found <name> to establish a realm with this colony as its capital.
imperium_realms.message.empire_status: REALM: %1$s (#%2$d) | Emperor: %3$s | Capital: %4$s | Provinces: %5$d | Imperial reserve: %6$d crowns | Provincial treasury total: %7$d crowns | Knowledge: %8$d | Average stability: %9$d
imperium_realms.message.empire_help: Use /imperium empire invite <colonyId> to invite a neighbour. The Emperor manages membership; each province owner accepts with /imperium empire join. Invitations expire after 7 in-game days. Non-capital provinces can leave.
imperium_realms.message.empire_already_m: This colony already belongs to an imperial realm.
imperium_realms.message.empire_found_fai: Could not found this realm. Choose a unique name of 3–32 characters and ensure the colony is not already a member.
imperium_realms.message.empire_founded: The Realm of %1$s has been founded (#%2$d). This colony is its capital and you are its Emperor.
imperium_realms.message.empire_target_no: No MineColonies colony with ID %1$d exists in this dimension.
imperium_realms.message.empire_target_me: That colony already belongs to an imperial realm.
imperium_realms.message.empire_invite_fa: Could not invite that colony. Check realm capacity and whether another realm already invited it.
imperium_realms.message.empire_invited: Invitation sent to %1$s (colony %2$d) to join %3$s. It expires after day %4$d.
imperium_realms.message.empire_invitatio: This colony has no valid invitation to an imperial realm.
imperium_realms.message.empire_joined: This colony is now a province of %1$s (#%2$d).
imperium_realms.message.empire_capital_c: The capital cannot leave its own realm. Found a successor capital or dissolve the realm in a later release.
imperium_realms.message.empire_leave_fai: This colony could not leave the realm.
imperium_realms.message.empire_deposit_p: Deposit failed. This province needs at least %1$d crowns available in its local treasury.
imperium_realms.message.empire_treasury_: The imperial reserve is at capacity (%1$d crowns). The provincial funds were returned.
imperium_realms.message.empire_deposited: Deposited %1$d crowns into the imperial reserve. New reserve balance: %2$d.
imperium_realms.message.empire_treasury_: The imperial reserve cannot withdraw %1$d crowns; the balance is insufficient.
imperium_realms.message.empire_province_: The province treasury is at capacity (%1$d crowns); the funds were returned to the imperial reserve.
imperium_realms.message.empire_withdrawn: Withdrew %1$d crowns to this province. Remaining imperial reserve: %2$d.
imperium_realms.message.parliament_scope: This is the imperial Parliament. Bills that pass here become law in every current province; new member provinces inherit them.
This is the provincial Parliament for %1$s. Bills here affect only this province.
This is a local Parliament. Found an empire to establish empire-wide laws through its capital.
imperium_realms.message.empire_law_statu: Imperial laws — shared tax rate: %1$s | shared economic policy: %2$s. When an imperial tax law is active, 10% of each province's collected tax receipts are transferred to the central reserve.
imperium_realms.message.empire_law_appli: Imperial law enacted: %1$s (%2$s) now applies across all %3$d provinces of %4$s.
imperium_realms.message.empire_law_apply: The bill passed, but the imperial law could not be synchronized. Please report this state; no new bill should be submitted until it is inspected.
imperium_realms.message.empire_audit_hea: Recent audit entries for %1$s (showing up to 10).
imperium_realms.message.empire_audit_emp: No imperial transactions have been audited yet.
imperium_realms.message.governor_empire_: Found or join an empire before appointing governors.
imperium_realms.message.governor_emperor: Only the Emperor or a server operator can appoint or dismiss provincial governors.
imperium_realms.message.governor_target_: No MineColonies colony with ID %1$d exists in this dimension.
imperium_realms.message.governor_not_mem: That colony is not a province of your empire.
imperium_realms.message.governor_capital: The capital is administered directly by the Emperor and cannot have a governor.
imperium_realms.message.governor_unchang: Could not appoint that player as governor of the selected province.
imperium_realms.message.governor_dismiss: The governor of %1$s has been dismissed.
imperium_realms.message.governor_none: That province has no governor to dismiss.
imperium_realms.message.governor_empty: No provincial governors are currently appointed.
imperium_realms.message.governor_help: The Emperor can appoint an online player to a non-capital province: /imperium governor appoint <colonyId> <player>. Dismiss with /imperium governor dismiss <colonyId>. Governed provinces gain +1 daily stability, +1 legitimacy and reduce unrest by 1.
imperium_realms.message.empire_events_he: Recent regional events in %1$s (showing up to 5).
imperium_realms.message.empire_events_em: No regional events have been recorded yet. The next event is scheduled after seven in-game days.
imperium_realms.regional_event.harvest-s: Harvest surplus: provincial income and central reserves improve.
imperium_realms.regional_event.merchants: Merchants' fair: trade brings extra crowns and modest public confidence.
imperium_realms.regional_event.scholarly: Scholarly exchange: knowledge grows, funded by provincial resources.
imperium_realms.regional_event.civic-rec: Civic reconciliation: stability and legitimacy recover while unrest falls.
imperium_realms.regional_event.border-te: Border tensions: the provinces become less stable and maintaining the realm costs crowns.
imperium_realms.regional_event.winter-sh: Winter shortages: reduced stores and knowledge strain stability and the public mood.
imperium_realms.regional_event.royal-pro: Royal progress: an imperial tour boosts confidence but requires local and central expenditure.
imperium_realms.message.empire_petitions: No separatist petitions are currently pending. Loyalty falls when provinces are unstable, legitimacy is low, unrest is high or taxes are excessive.
imperium_realms.message.empire_petition_: The Emperor may resolve a petition with /imperium empire resolve <colonyId> reassure or /imperium empire resolve <colonyId> crackdown. Reassurance costs 50 crowns and improves local legitimacy/stability; crackdown costs 25 crowns but worsens unrest and legitimacy.
That province has no pending separatist petition.
The imperial reserve needs at least %1$d crowns to carry out that response.
%1$s has been reassured for %2$d crowns. Loyalty is now %3$d/100; stability, legitimacy and unrest improve.
The crown has imposed a crackdown in %1$s for %2$d crowns. Loyalty is now %3$d/100, but stability and legitimacy fall and unrest rises.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_limit_r: This province already has the maximum of %1$d simultaneous strategic operations.
imperium_realms.message.campaign_posture: Military posture: %1$s | Launch readiness bonus: +%2$d | Defensive readiness bonus: +%3$d

%1$s now uses %2$s posture. Launch bonus: +%3$d; defence bonus: +%4$d. Ongoing operations keep their launch-readiness snapshot; the defending province's posture and supply are checked when they resolve.
Unknown military posture. Choose balanced, defensive or offensive.
imperium_realms.message.supply_routes_he: Supply routes of %1$s — Routes: %2$d | Imperial reserve: %3$d crowns
imperium_realms.message.supply_routes_em: No supply routes have been built. Build a route from the imperial capital to one of its member provinces.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_ent: To %1$s (colony %2$d): condition %3$d/100 | %4$s | Built day %5$d | Last upkeep day %6$d
imperium_realms.message.supply_routes_he: An Emperor/server operator can build a direct capital-to-province route with /imperium empire route build <colonyId>. Cost: %1$d crowns; upkeep: %2$d crowns per in-game day. Routes below %3$d/100 condition stop providing military logistics bonuses.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_emp: Only the Emperor or a server operator can spend the imperial reserve on supply infrastructure.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_not: The target colony must already be a member province in your empire.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_cap: The capital is the supply hub and does not need a route to itself.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_exi: A supply route to that province already exists.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_fun: The imperial reserve needs at least %1$d crowns to construct this route.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_bui: The supply route could not be built. Check membership, cost and route status.
A supply route to %1$s has been built for %2$d crowns. Imperial reserve remaining: %3$d.
imperium_realms.message.defensive_orders: Defensive orders in %1$s — Active: %2$d | Imperial reserve: %3$d crowns
There are no active defensive orders.
imperium_realms.message.defensive_order_: %1$s (colony %2$d): issued by %3$s on day %4$d, expires day %5$d; +%6$d defensive readiness
imperium_realms.message.defensive_orders: The Emperor/server operator can issue a temporary order with /imperium empire defense <colonyId>. Cost: %1$d crowns; duration: %2$d in-game days; effect: +%3$d defensive readiness when targeted.
Only the Emperor or a server operator can spend the imperial reserve on defensive orders.
imperium_realms.message.defensive_order_: Defensive order issued to %1$s for %2$d crowns. It lasts %3$d in-game days and adds +%4$d readiness when defending. Imperial reserve remaining: %5$d.
That province already has an active defensive order.
The imperial reserve needs at least %1$d crowns for this order.
The defensive order could not be issued. Check membership, funds and order status.
imperium_realms.message.theatre_header: Strategic theatre — %1$s | Capital: %2$s | Provinces: %3$d | Imperial reserve: %4$d crowns | Active routes: %5$d | Defensive orders: %6$d
imperium_realms.message.theatre_province: [%1$s] %2$s (#%3$d) | Focus: %4$s | Loyalty: %5$d/100 | Treasury: %6$d | Stability: %7$d | Unrest: %8$d | Active operations: %9$d | Supply: %10$s | Defence: %11$s
imperium_realms.message.theatre_help: This overview is read-only. Use /imperium empire routes, /imperium empire defenses and /imperium empire defense <colonyId> to manage logistics and defensive orders.
imperium_realms.message.supply_route_pri: No unsupplied member province needs a new route, or the realm has no registered province state.
Priority supply route built to %1$s (colony %2$d) for %3$d crowns. Remaining central reserve: %4$d crowns.
imperium_realms.message.defense_priority: No eligible province was found for an emergency defensive order.
Emergency defence was prioritised for %1$s (colony %2$d). Cost: %3$d crowns; duration: %4$d days; readiness bonus: +%5$d. Central reserve remaining: %6$d crowns.
imperium_realms.message.empire_map_heade: Strategic map for %1$s — capital dimension: %2$s — mapped colonies: %3$d of %4$d.
imperium_realms.message.empire_map_orien: H marks the capital; * means multiple colonies share one map cell. North (lower Z) is at the top; east (+X) is right.
imperium_realms.message.empire_map_cross: %1$s (colony %2$d) is outside this map in dimension %3$s at X %4$d, Z %5$d.
imperium_realms.message.empire_map_unres: %1$s (colony %2$d, %3$s) is not currently resolvable to a loaded MineColonies colony; its saved realm record remains available.
imperium_realms.message.empire_map_no_ce: No loaded MineColonies colony centers could be plotted. The map will populate when at least one realm colony is available.
